title: Understand which documented behavior is enabled
statement: As a newcomer, I can see which features and stories are gated and whether they are enabled, so that I do not mistake unavailable behavior for missing implementation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each feature flag lists the features or stories it gates.
Each feature flag shows whether it is on, off, or retired.
A story gated by an off flag remains documented but is shown as not enabled.
Retiring a feature flag preserves its history.
